hooks.command: echo 'RESPONSE STANDARD (local-workflow): every reply you write to the user follows the user-facing-communication skill, whether or not a workflow command is running. Open with what was done and the current state, and be exact about that state: planned, implemented, verified and committed are different things, and local work stops at a commit unless you say otherwise. Put anything outstanding, blocked or assumed where it cannot be missed. Name every work item by identifier AND title, never a bare number. Leave out investigation history, file lists and test names. Full standard: skills/user-facing-communication/SKILL.md.'
